_meta.description: Hub behaviour on bad input (in-process, real handler code).

cases.name: invalid access key
cases.note: tornado close() with no code: client sees a close frame with no status (1005)

cases.name: BUS message whose type is not in allowed_types
cases.sent_plaintext: {"msg_type": "bus", "payload": {"type": "speak", "data": {"utterance": "not allowed"}, "context": {"session": {"session_id": "6b1e3c1f-6a8f-4d7e-9a43-0c2c5b1e7f10", "lang": "en-US", "site_id": "phone", "location": {"timezone": {"code": "America/New_York", "name": "Eastern Standard Time", "offset": -18000000, "dstOffset": 3600000}}, "system_unit": "imperial", "time_format": "half", "date_format": "MDY"}}}, "metadata": {}, "route": [], "node": null, "target_site_id": null, "target_pubkey": null, "source_peer": null}
cases.note: hub logs a warning and drops it; nothing is sent back

cases.name: unknown cipher name in client HANDSHAKE
cases.note: unknown names raise in _norm_cipher/_norm_encoding -> exception in on_message -> tornado aborts the TCP connection (no close frame, client sees 1006). Known-but-not-allowed names lead to client.disconnect() (close frame, no status).
